scope: Regression on the same48 tuning windows; not independent quality, fullmodel or TTFT
limitations: Same48 windows already used to tune range, so this is development regression.
32rows perwindow fromS64/128,D64/128/192/256 prompts; not full dynamic prefill.
FP32 source history, not captured NPU KV.
1warmup+2repeat for determinism, not robust timing distributions.
No fullmodel logits or naturalaction generation, speech/RAG concurrency, or long-term stability.

hidden_regression_change.caution: Wider representable range doubles quantization step; tiny ordinary-case regressions coexist with large outlier improvements.

limits_note: This result is a successful numerical regression against the4knownrangeoutliers, not acceptance of allNPU layers/fullmodel quality.
